meta.purpose: Approval-ready plan for turning staged Notion products into READY candidates without editing runtime data.

decisionSummary.recommendedNextMove: Approve a small code normalization batch before importing real products.
decisionSummary.why: The Product Group structure works, but READY is blocked by Item/Manual taxonomy gaps.
doNotDoYet: Do not import products into app-data.js.
Do not create P1/P2/P3 individual product cards.
Do not attach products to loosely related Item Groups just to make them visible.

batchA_existingCodeAbsorption.description: No new Item Code required. Normalize or broaden existing Product Group meanings, then these products can become READY candidates.

items.decision: Treat deodorant/deo pact products as Grooming > 체취 / 데오 관리.
items.effect: Can move from REVIEW to READY after domain/topic normalization.
items.risk: Notion source code currently points to BD-BC, so source code should be normalized or documented.

items.decision: Broaden Body recovery Product Group from massage ball only to recovery device / neck-shoulder massage.
items.effect: Can move from REVIEW to READY if group label is broadened.
items.risk: If kept as '마사지볼 회복 루틴', product feels mismatched.

items.decision: Choose canonical scalp care code before import.
items.optionRecommended: Create/standardize GR-SC for scalp care if Grooming owns scalp products.
productsCovered: 케라스타즈 제네시스 옴므 세럼 안티-슈트 포티피앙
items.effect: Can move 2 products from REVIEW to READY after canonical code decision.
items.risk: Leaving scalp split between SK-HR and GR-SC will create repeated reviewNeeded cases.

items.decision: Decide whether SK-SS means daily sunscreen generally or only wound pigmentation sunscreen.
items.effect: Can become READY only if SK-SS is broadened or a dedicated daily sunscreen item/manual is created.
items.risk: Current label '상처 선크림/패치' is too narrow for daily SPF.

batchB_newCodeCandidates.description: New Item/Manual Code recommended before importing these product families.

recommendedApprovalOrder: Approve Batch A normalization first to make 4-5 staged products READY with minimal structural change.
Approve Batch B new Item/Manual candidates only after reviewing names and code topics.
Then generate app-data.generated.js candidate, not app-data.js direct edit.
Finally run browser QA before merging generated data into the prototype.
